environment.description: Service deployed in a private subnet (10.200.0.0/24) behind an AWS Network Load Balancer (NLB) with a target group health check on /health. The NLB listener on port 8443 has an associated VPC security group (sg-0a3f8e91c) that restricts inbound traffic. However, the primary network-level restriction is implemented via VPC subnet route table configuration: the private subnet has no internet gateway route, and the NLB resides in a separate public subnet with its own security group (sg-0b7c2d44a) that has an inbound allow rule scoped to a prefix list (pl-0x8f3a21e7b) containing only three CIDR blocks: 10.50.0.0/16 (internal data center), 172.20.128.0/17 (edge node VPN pool), and 192.168.200.0/24 (NOC management). The NLB preserves client IP via proxy protocol v2, and the target group security group (sg-0a3f8e91c) only allows ingress from the NLB's ENI security group. There is no NAT gateway or bastion with public-facing access in the VPC. DNS resolution for the service endpoint is only available via Route53 private hosted zone associated with the VPC.
